ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud and the methods used by scammers to exploit the system
questions: What are the most common methods used by scammers to commit Medicaid fraud?
How can the system be improved to prevent fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and highlight the need for increased scrutiny of Medicaid claims. By analyzing data and conducting investigative reporting, we can shed light on the scope of the problem and identify potential solutions.
